name: GPT Images to Tripo3d
summary: Turn text prompts into images, create Tripo 3D models, and save FBX files to your computer.
description:
Text prompts to images. Images to Tripo 3D. FBX to your computer.

Build a queue of reference images in ChatGPT, turn those images into models in Tripo Studio, and keep each FBX export with its reference in a folder you choose.

Prompts to images
Paste your image prompts into the GPT images tab. Each prompt runs in a new ChatGPT chat. The first generated image is saved directly to your selected folder, ready for the model queue.

Images to Tripo models
Use existing reference images or watch the folder for new ones. Process one image at a time with your chosen Tripo Studio settings. Set a credit ceiling per model and a model count for each run.

Models to local FBX
Save each export into its own folder with the reference image. ZIP exports retain their companion files and texture paths. The root reference is removed only after the export and reference copy have been verified.

Resume interrupted work
Resume a saved job, connect an existing Studio model, or import a downloaded FBX/ZIP. Stop a run after the current model finishes.

Before you start
• Desktop Chrome 120 or newer.
• Signed-in ChatGPT and Tripo Studio accounts with the required image-generation and FBX-export features.
• Sufficient service credits or usage allowance. Subscriptions and credits are separate from this free extension.
• Keep the control tab, service tabs and selected drive available during a run.

No API key, local server or native helper is required. The extension uses the services’ web interfaces, which may change. Start with one model and inspect its output before running a larger batch.

Data and privacy
Prompts go to ChatGPT and reference images go to Tripo when you start their queues. Settings, queues and recovery records stay locally. The extension has no developer-operated backend, analytics or telemetry.

Independent extension. Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Tripo.
single_purpose: Move user-requested image prompts through ChatGPT image generation and Tripo Studio model generation to organized local FBX exports.

permissions.storage: Stores queue state, prompts, options and selected tab information locally so interrupted work can resume.
permissions.tabs: Finds the user-selected ChatGPT and Tripo tabs, opens workflow pages and returns to saved conversations and models.
permissions.scripting: Injects only bundled ChatGPT and Tripo scripts into their validated supported tabs when the existing receiver is unavailable, such as after extension reload.
permissions.host_permissions: Automation is limited to ChatGPT and supported Tripo pages. HTTPS access is also needed to fetch signed FBX/ZIP export URLs supplied by Tripo, whose external file-host domains can vary. Export requests omit credentials and referrers. No scripts are injected into unrelated sites.

reviewer_instructions: Chrome 120+. Sign in to ChatGPT (image generation enabled) and Tripo Studio (credits + FBX export access). Choose a test folder via Folder settings. GPT images: select ChatGPT tab, add an image prompt, Start prompts. Tripo models: select Studio tab; choose Studio settings, set credit ceiling, Models this run=1, Start batch. Check FBX/reference output. Services consume credits/usage. No test credentials supplied. Local UI checks passed; full live workflow not verified in this session.
